question: Among users who have obtained the 'Teacher' badge, consider their posts created between 2011 and 2013 that have at least 2 votes. For each year in this range, find the user whose posts in that year have the highest total view count, and return only the year and that user's display name (DisplayName) for each year in the final answer.

prediction.sql:
WITH teacher_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_052" AS user_id, u."XCL_055" AS display_name
    FROM badges b
    INNER JOIN users u ON b."XCL_002" = u."XCL_052"
    WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Teacher'
),
qualified_posts AS (
    SELECT p."XCL_026" AS post_id, p."XCL_033" AS user_id, p."XCL_029" AS creation_date, p."XCL_030" AS view_count
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN teacher_users tu ON p."XCL_033" = tu.user_id
    WHERE p."XCL_029" >= '2011-01-01' AND p."XCL_029" < '2014-01-01'
),
posts_with_votes AS (
    SELECT qp.post_id, qp.user_id, qp.creation_date, qp.view_count, COUNT(v."XCL_066") AS vote_count
    FROM qualified_posts qp
    INNER JOIN votes v ON qp.post_id = v."XCL_067"
    GROUP BY qp.post_id, qp.user_id, qp.creation_date, qp.view_count
    HAVING COUNT(v."XCL_066") >= 2
),
user_year_stats AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y', pvs.creation_date) AS year,
        pvs.user_id,
        SUM(pvs.view_count) AS total_views
    FROM posts_with_votes pvs
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', pvs.creation_date), pvs.user_id
),
ranked_users AS (
    SELECT
        uys.year,
        uys.user_id,
        uys.total_views,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY uys.year ORDER BY uys.total_views DESC) AS rnk
    FROM user_year_stats uys
)
SELECT
    ru.year,
    tu.display_name
FROM ranked_users ru
INNER JOIN teacher_users tu ON ru.user_id = tu.user_id
WHERE ru.rnk = 1
ORDER BY ru.year

WITH teacher_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_052" AS user_id, u."XCL_055" AS display_name
    FROM badges b
    INNER JOIN users u ON b."XCL_002" = u."XCL_052"
    WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Teacher'
),
qualified_posts AS (
    SELECT p."XCL_026" AS post_id, p."XCL_033" AS user_id, p."XCL_029" AS creation_date, p."XCL_030" AS view_count
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN teacher_users tu ON p."XCL_033" = tu.user_id
    WHERE p."XCL_029" >= '2011-01-01' AND p."XCL_029" < '2014-01-01'
),
posts_with_votes AS (
    SELECT qp.post_id, qp.user_id, qp.creation_date, qp.view_count, COUNT(v."XCL_066") AS vote_count
    FROM qualified_posts qp
    INNER JOIN votes v ON qp.post_id = v."XCL_067"
    GROUP BY qp.post_id, qp.user_id, qp.creation_date, qp.view_count
    HAVING COUNT(v."XCL_066") >= 2
),
user_year_stats AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y', pvs.creation_date) AS year,
        pvs.user_id,
        SUM(pvs.view_count) AS total_views
    FROM posts_with_votes pvs
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', pvs.creation_date), pvs.user_id
),
ranked_users AS (
    SELECT
        uys.year,
        uys.user_id,
        uys.total_views,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY uys.year ORDER BY uys.total_views DESC) AS rnk
    FROM user_year_stats uys
)
SELECT
    ru.year,
    tu.display_name
FROM ranked_users ru
INNER JOIN teacher_users tu ON ru.user_id = tu.user_id
WHERE ru.rnk = 1
ORDER BY ru.year

        COUNT(v.XCL_066) AS vote_count
    FROM posts p
    JOIN teacher_users tu ON p.XCL_033 = tu.user_id
    LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.XCL_026 = v.XCL_067
    WHERE p.XCL_029 >= '2011-01-01' AND p.XCL_029 < '2014-01-01'
    GROUP BY p.XCL_026, p.XCL_033, p.XCL_029, p.XCL_039
    HAVING COUNT(v.XCL_066) >= 2
),
yearly_user_views AS (
    SELECT 
        STRFTIME('%Y', qp.creation_date) AS year,
        qp.user_id,
        SUM(qp.view_count) AS total_views
    FROM qualified_posts qp
    GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y', qp.creation_date), qp.user_id
),
ranked_users AS (
    SELECT 
        yuv.year,
        yuv.user_id,
        yuv.total_views,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY yuv.year ORDER BY yuv.total_views DESC) AS rnk
    FROM yearly_user_views yuv
)
SELECT 
    ru.year,
    u.XCL_057 AS DisplayName
FROM ranked_users ru
JOIN users u ON ru.user_id = u.XCL_052
WHERE ru.rnk = 1
ORDER BY ru.year
